route_note: Consonant-skeleton span match against an authoritative text. Routes (a) and (b) are closed: ID carries no verse reference, and the organizers publish no test Arabic (test_references is ID+phonemes, QuranMB.v2 is ID+audio, Iqra_Extra_IS26 is gated). The query is the skeleton of reference_arabic_string, which the uploader derived from reference_phoneme_string, so this REPRODUCES the uploader's recovery and does not independently validate it. The independent instrument is scripts/verify_verse_map.py (human listening).

phonetize_ceiling: 97/98 by construction: prompts 9 and 42 share one Arabic string but have different phoneme strings (pausal vs liaison final word), and phonetize is deterministic, so both cannot match. Subtract this BEFORE reading the exact-match count, not after.
